body: Post-merge STRICT review of 29b6c9b: CHANGES. LIVE HAZARD: bgwait starts the child as an & job, so SIGINT and SIGQUIT are ignored for cargo, rustc and test binaries. Also blocking: the stale-ticket check is kill -0 only (pid reuse can wedge the queue; reproduced); cargo kill substring over-matching ('aida' matches every build), with no confirmation, and it misclassifies live builds as ORPHAN when run from a dev checkout; the R74 test is non-hermetic. The queue protocol itself is sound and draining. Per the operator (fix forward, no revert), a claude fixer is doing it on branch claude/fix-29b with a PR. Please do NOT push to aida-host bin/cargo, cargo-kill, cargo-ps or cargo-log until that PR merges, to avoid collisions. Process note: wrapper changes go through a branch and PR, never in-place edits to the primary checkout. That checkout IS the live wrapper, and edits while builds run can execute half-written code.
subject: 29b6c9b post-merge review: CHANGES; a claude fixer is taking the fix-forward
